2.10 Recycling Rule of Vectors

c(1, 2, 3, 4) + c(1, 2)

[1] 2 4 4 6

# c(1, 2, 3, 4) + c(1, 2, 1, 2)

\[
    \begin{bmatrix}
        1 \\
        2 \\
        3 \\
        4
    \end{bmatrix} +
    \begin{bmatrix}
       1 \\
       2
    \end{bmatrix} \xrightarrow{recyle}
    \begin{bmatrix}
        1 \\
        2 \\
        3 \\
        4
    \end{bmatrix} +
    \begin{bmatrix}
       1 \\
       2 \\
       1 \\
       2
    \end{bmatrix} \xrightarrow{add}
    \begin{bmatrix}
        2 \\
        4 \\
        4 \\
        6
    \end{bmatrix}
\]

title: 3  Control Flow
text:
4.2 Statistical Computations
\(n\) is sample size, \(\overline{y}\) is the mean, \(s\) is standard deviation \[
    t = \frac{\overline{y_1} - \overline{y_2}}{s_p \sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1} + \frac{1}{n_2}}} \
\] \(s_e\) is standard error \[
    s_e = s_p \sqrt{\frac{1}{n_1} + \frac{1}{n_2}}
\] \(s_p\) is pooled estimate of the standard deviation(合并标准差估计) $$ s_p^2 = \
t = \frac{\overline{y_1} - \overline{y_2}}{s_e}
$$ var(x)：方差 \(s^2\) sd(x)：标准差 \(s\)

diff.mean = function(y1, y2) {
    mean(y1) - mean(y2)
}

sp = function(y1, y2){
    n1 = length(y1)
    n2 = length(y2)
    sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var(y1) + (n2 - 1) * var(y2)) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
}

pooled.se = function(y1, y2) {
    n1 = length(y1)
    n2 = length(y2)

    sp(y1, y2) * sqrt(1 / n1 + 1 / n2)
}

t.val = function(y1, y2){
    diff.mean(y1, y2) / pooled.se(y1, y2)
}

ttest = function(y1, y2){
    n1 = length(y1)
    n2 = length(y2)
    tval = t.val(y1, y2)
    pval = 2 * pt(-abs(tval), n1 + n2 - 2)
    list(t = tval, df = n1 + n2 -2, pval = pval)
    # df = degree of freedom
    # t = mean / 差距随机波动多少
    # pval = 观察到当前这么大或者更大的差距,概率为pval%
}

y2 = rnorm(10) + 2

5.1 Poker Hands

x = c(2, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 3, 3, 1, 1, 3, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 3)
hands = function(x) {
    number.of.hands = length(x) %/% 3
    i = seq_len(number.of.hands)

    a = x[3 * i - 2]
    b = x[3 * i - 1]
    c = x[3 * i]

    hand1 = a != b & a != c & b != c
    hand3 = a == b & b == c
    hand2 = !hand1 & !hand3

    c(
        hand1 = sum(hand1),
        hand2 = sum(hand2),
        hand3 = sum(hand3)
    )
}
hands(x)

hand1 hand2 hand3 
    2     3     1 

system.time(hands(x))

   user  system elapsed 
      0       0       0
